headline: US–Iran Ceasefire Brings Temporary Relief Amid Escalating Middle East Conflict
summary: A temporary US-Iran ceasefire has eased tensions after intense military strikes, according to reports. The truce's durability was not specified in the input.
why: Hostilities involving Iran affect Gulf oil flows and shipping routes, which feed directly into energy prices and global market sentiment.
